notes_for_editor: Three sources give 1929 (Canada Lookouts list, plus the English and French BaladoDecouverte listings), but all are secondary and none is an archival record. The listing credits the Ministry of Natural Resources for 1929; the oocities page says the Department of Lands and Forests became the ministry in 1972, so the agency name for 1929 is unsettled. The story gives both without choosing. The Ontario GeoHub tower layer (cached at data/raw/ontario_lio/fire_towers.geojson, OBJECTID 616) has a point at the record's coordinates with GENERAL_COMMENTS 'Constructed in 1929' and GEOG_UNIT_DESCR 'no cabin on top'. The second value suggests the cab is gone, but the GeoHub page is JavaScript-only and fetch_text cannot quote it, so the story does not use it. A human could check and add a citable source. The record's elevation_m 294.0 matches firelookout.ca's 'Elevation 294 m (965 ft)', which is ground elevation, not tower height, so it is not in facts. Possible access restriction: the French listing says the park's hiking trails should be avoided by people riding off-trail (il faut éviter de croiser les sentiers de randonnée pédestre); the wording is ambiguous, so check Ontario Parks before publishing any access advice. No staffing or fire data found. The 2017 YouTube video and geocache GC58C0W appeared in search results but were not read, so they are not cited.
